title: Total XOR of All Subarray XORs
description: Given an integer array `nums`, compute the bitwise XOR of every non-empty contiguous subarray, and then return the bitwise XOR of all those subarray XOR values combined.
hints: Count how many contiguous subarrays include index `i`: there are `(i + 1)` choices for the left endpoint and `(n - i)` choices for the right endpoint, giving `(i + 1) * (n - i)` occurrences.
Because `x ^ x = 0`, `nums[i]` contributes only when `(i + 1) * (n - i)` is odd, which occurs if and only if `n` is odd and `i` is even.

examples.explanation: Subarray XORs are 1, 2, 3, (1^2)=3, (2^3)=1, (1^2^3)=0; XORing all of them gives 2.
Because length n = 4 is even, every element appears in an even number of subarrays, so the result is 0.
With a single element [9], the only subarray has XOR 9.
